name: Dr. Joyjit Chatterjee
role: Lead Data Scientist at EPAM Systems
headline: Turning AI ambition into enterprise value.
intro: I connect AI strategy, product development and operational delivery, bringing research, people and technology together to solve enterprise challenges in R&D, manufacturing, supply chains and energy.
about: I work at the intersection of AI strategy, product development and enterprise operations. As Lead Data Scientist at EPAM Systems, I lead AI/ML engagements, help shape opportunities and delivery teams, and work with senior stakeholders on value, adoption and governance. Previously at Reckitt, I translated research into a production application for product shelf-life prediction and developed analytics for manufacturing and supply operations. My work combines hands-on technical depth with cross-functional delivery, mentoring and industry–academic collaboration. I hold a PhD in Computer Science from the University of Hull and am a Distinguished Visiting Fellow at Loughborough University.

appointments.title: Distinguished Visiting Fellow
appointments.summary: Contribute to research embedding and industry impact in the Language & Data Research Group, including industry–academic collaboration and research impact development. Previously Visiting Academic, Mar 2025 – Feb 2026.

details.heading: Distinguished Visiting Fellow, March 2026 onwards
points: Voluntary appointment in the Language & Data Research Group recognising past and continuing contributions to AI embedding through publications, guest lectures and advice on industry–academic collaboration.

details.heading: Visiting Academic, March 2025 to February 2026
points: Invited as an industry expert to support research embedding and impact creation for students and academics.
Provided voluntary insights at the intersection of AI, natural language processing and sustainability, with an emphasis on ethical, inclusive and internationally impactful research.
Delivered guest lectures and invited talks, advised on the Research Excellence Framework, and offered mentoring and career guidance to PhD students and researchers.

appointments.title: Visiting Academic
appointments.summary: AI and data science research collaboration, industry–academic knowledge exchange and careers mentoring.

details.heading: Research impact, teaching and careers
points: Provide voluntary career advice to students and collaborate on research dissemination with Hull’s Big Data Analytics Research Group.
Deliver guest lectures and Computer Science talks as an invited industry expert in AI/ML, particularly through DAIM.
Continue industry–academic collaboration following the KTP, helping Hull and Reckitt develop evidence for research impact case studies, including the Research Excellence Framework.

experience.title: Lead Data Scientist
experience.summary: Lead AI/ML consulting and delivery for Fortune 500 and FTSE 250 organisations across R&D, manufacturing, procurement and supply services. Contribute to multi-million-pound engagements across Europe and North America, from use-case discovery, proposals and proof of value to delivery and governance. Help assemble project teams through technical and project interviews, mentor data scientists and senior data scientists, and work with senior leaders and domain experts.

details.heading: Client delivery and opportunity development
points: Direct client delivery projects for Reckitt and Syngenta Group.

Supported the EPAM team with pitching and identifying ML and GenAI use cases for Qatar Airways, Unilever, Barry Callebaut, Brussels Airport Company, Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, Adidas, Co-op, Currys and PPG Industries.
Supported pre-sales through solution pitches, RFP responses for new and existing accounts, and project planning.

details.heading: AI strategy, products and delivery
points: Lead AI/ML solution development across R&D, manufacturing, procurement and supply services for Fortune 500 and FTSE 250 organisations within the UK and Western Europe AI/ML Consulting team.
Contribute to multi-million-pound data science engagements across Europe and North America, working with cross-functional global teams, client senior leadership and subject-matter experts.
Identify suitable business use cases, data streams, modelling approaches and governance strategies for decision support, cost efficiency and speed to market.
Work across strategy and governance, proof of concept, proof of value and end-to-end AI consulting, including GenAI engineering, data analytics and data science.

details.heading: Teams and knowledge sharing
points: Conduct technical and project interviews to help hire and assemble business analysts, data scientists and data engineers for client projects.
Mentor data scientists and senior data scientists.
Author articles for EPAM’s Supply Chain Management community, co-organise educational AI workshops for clients and review editorial content for the GenAI-X community.

details.heading: Technology and implementation
points: LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, LangChain, PhiData, CrewAI and Azure OpenAI Service.
Python, Retool, Postman, pgAdmin and APIs for end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI solutions.

experience.title: IT & Digital Data Scientist - Supply Chain / Senior Business Analyst
experience.organization: Reckitt (formerly Reckitt Benckiser Group PLC), Hull, UK
experience.summary: Developed manufacturing analytics for continued process verification, connecting SAP, quality, environmental and process data. Supported the adoption of causal AI across factories and contributed to approximately 30% waste reduction in major UK factories. Built decision-support tools for logistics consolidation and Agile capacity planning, engaged quality and IT leadership, and mentored graduates and interns. Predictive analytics demonstrated savings potential of up to £300k per year in evaluation.

details.heading: Business scope and cross-functional delivery
points: Worked with IT&D, R&D, Supply and Global Data Science teams across the UK, USA, India and Poland on pharmaceutical and nutraceutical brands including Nurofen, Strepsils and Airborne, supporting a multi-billion-pound portfolio.
Presented AI innovation outcomes to the SVP Quality and SVP IT&D Supply, and engaged the CIO and Global Data Science team through Reckitt’s AI/ML Community of Practice.

details.heading: Manufacturing quality, waste and operational performance
points: Developed a scalable data model for Continued Process Verification (CPV), covering formulation and packaging, manufacturing stages, input raw-material attributes and finished-product outputs.
Integrated SAP, environmental management, quality-control and historian process-parameter data with input from subject-matter experts across Europe and North America.

Performed exploratory analysis, preprocessing, statistical analysis, nonlinear predictive modelling, root-cause analysis and causal inference. Evaluation demonstrated savings potential of up to £300k per year.
Contributed to approximately 30% waste reduction in major UK factories and to the adoption of data-led continuous improvement in manufacturing and quality control.

Targeted the availability, quality and performance components of Overall Equipment Effectiveness through predictive maintenance, CPV, predictive stability and real-time insights, with an emphasis on reducing raw-material and packaging waste.

details.heading: Operational tools and accessible insights
points: Used open-source LLMs through Ollama and LangChain to turn complex manufacturing analytics into explanations accessible to subject-matter experts.
Built models for Agile team capacity and resource planning using historical Program Increment data, user stories and feature counts.
Developed a Cost-to-Serve logistics tool to identify shipment consolidation opportunities and convert Less than Truck Load (LTL) into Full Truck Load (FTL).

details.heading: Adoption, proof of value and connected initiatives
points: Led the IT&D contribution to adopting a causal-AI manufacturing analytics platform, supporting factory proof-of-value demonstrations, data transformations and strategic engagement with subject-matter experts.
Expanded predictive stability analysis by connecting Ongoing Stability Studies data from SAP and QC Supply with the existing R&D model built using LIMS data.
Initiated a predictive-maintenance proof of concept using factory condition-monitoring data.
Supported manufacturing colleagues in encouraging augmented- and virtual-reality adoption for predictive maintenance and training operations and maintenance personnel.

details.heading: Industry forums, responsible AI and mentoring
points: Represented Reckitt at the FMCG CQO Roundtable alongside quality leaders from Unilever, ELC Europe, Sanofi, Haleon, Galderma and Kenvue.
Joined the EthonAI expert roundtable “From Statistics to Causal AI” with industry leaders from Bosch, Lindt, Infineon Technologies and SFS Group.
Presented at internal forums including the Global QC Excellence Forum and delivered talks in Global QC workshops.
Contributed case studies for Responsible AI training, educated supply-chain colleagues through workshops, and mentored graduates and interns while delegating appropriate tasks.

experience.title: IT & Digital Data Scientist - R&D / KTP Associate
experience.organization: Reckitt (formerly Reckitt Benckiser Group PLC), Hull, UK
experience.summary: Led the AI workstream of a jointly funded Innovate UK Knowledge Transfer Partnership, translating chemistry and laboratory research into a shelf-life prediction application. Worked across R&D, data science, engineering and UI/UX teams on models, accessible interfaces and cloud deployment. Helped shape the longer-term use of AI in product design and testing and supported adoption through workshops and leadership engagement. The partnership received an Outstanding grade; evaluation demonstrated potential annual savings of $780k and 10,000 lab hours.

details.heading: Partnership and recognised delivery
points: Led the AI workstream in a $200k jointly funded Knowledge Transfer Partnership between Reckitt and the University of Hull, supported by Innovate UK and UKRI.
The partnership received Innovate UK’s Certificate of Excellence with an Outstanding rating, the highest possible grade.

details.heading: From research to a usable AI product
points: Developed an AI application for decision support in shelf-life prediction of healthcare products, estimating active-ingredient overage early in development.

Worked from model development through production application development, including accessible interfaces and user experience, collaborating with Reckitt’s Global Data Science team on cloud deployment.
Combined laboratory data with chemistry knowledge to improve stability prediction and formulation optimisation, including limited-data settings, for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.
Collaborated with R&D scientists, ML engineers, data scientists and UI/UX developers across North America and Europe to plan development and meet milestones and deliverables.

details.heading: Evaluation and resource efficiency
points: Evaluation demonstrated potential annual reductions of approximately $780k in stability-testing costs and 10,000 laboratory hours, with potential energy savings of more than 2,000 kWh per year.
Helped reduce raw-material waste by predicting early which new formulations were likely to fail intended shelf-life specifications.
Coauthored a poster accepted for Reckitt’s first Science Inside Symposium, organised by the Chief R&D Officer in Hull.

details.heading: AI adoption and longer-term strategy
points: Helped shape a long-term plan for intelligent data analysis in product design and testing, translating research into commercially useful corporate applications.
Investigated explainable AI components to make predictions transparent and build understanding of the domain.
Supported AI awareness and uptake through TechTalks with senior leadership including the CIO, presentations to the SVP IT&D R&D, and cohosting AI forums for the IT&D R&D group.
Developed colleagues’ data and AI capabilities through learning sessions, specialist workshops and regular discussion.

details.heading: Data scale and decision-support workflow
points: The Hull presentation reports approximately 60,000 stability-result data points, more than 1,000 stability studies and 66 analytes.

The application predicts the shelf-life of active ingredients during new-product development and existing-product optimisation. Predictive outputs support formulation decisions alongside laboratory stability studies.

experience.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
experience.summary: Pursued R&D in hybrid AI models combining laboratory data with chemistry domain-specific knowledge for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical product development. Collaborated with Reckitt on R&D NPD & EPD applications. Contributed to recruitment panels, PhD co-supervision and talks for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

details.heading: Applied research and knowledge transfer
points: Developed hybrid AI models combining LIMS laboratory data with domain-specific chemistry information, including SMILES molecular fingerprints of active pharmaceutical ingredients.
Collaborated with Reckitt through the KTP on accelerating new and existing pharmaceutical and nutraceutical product development in the FMCG industry.
Translated academic findings into commercially useful solutions and communicated technical concepts to academic and industry stakeholders.
Documented research through technical reports and publications.

details.heading: Academic leadership and developing researchers
points: Served on recruitment panels interviewing postdoctoral researchers and research associates in data analytics, data science and AI.
Mentored PhD students as a co-supervisor and delivered talks to BSc and MSc students, including through Hull’s Centre of Excellence for Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Modelling (DAIM).

experience.title: Visiting Researcher
experience.summary: Visiting research stay at the University of Bremen as part of the Green Talents Award from the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF). Collaborated on sustainable AI and energy research.

details.heading: Green Talents research visit and EisAuge
points: Research visit supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research’s Green Talents Award, with virtual work in June–July 2022 and an in-person stay in July–August 2022.
Worked on the EisAuge project, developing deep-learning and transfer-learning approaches for detecting ice on wind turbine blades.
Developed a generalised ice-detection system designed to transfer predictions across wind farms when trained on data from a single, distinct farm.

experience.title: PhD Student-Researcher
experience.summary: Conducted doctoral research on "Explainable AI for Operations & Maintenance of Wind Turbines" under the supervision of Dr. Nina Dethlefs. Developed novel AI techniques for fault detection, diagnosis, and prognosis using SCADA data.

details.heading: Explainable decision support for offshore wind
points: Applied deep learning to turbine sensor (SCADA) data and alarm records to support engineers and technicians in wind turbine operations and maintenance.
Investigated anomaly prediction, maintenance planning and condition-based monitoring to improve reliability and reduce downtime and operations and maintenance costs.
Used natural language generation, temporal causal inference and knowledge graphs to explain anomalies, plan maintenance and generate understandable decision-support reports.
Developed a complete question-answering system combining AI models with a domain-specific knowledge graph for interactive maintenance decision support.

details.heading: Collaboration and dissemination
points: Collaborated with wind-farm operators and research organisations including ORE Catapult.
Worked within the Aura Wind Energy PhD Cluster and Hull’s Dependable Intelligent Systems / Big Data Analytics Research Group.
Presented research internally and externally, including Aura events and the Big Data Analytics Research Group’s annual workshop.

experience.title: Technology Intern
experience.summary: Technology internship as part of Internship Experience UK programme. Focused on Agile Software Development, Communications, Product Development Planning and Testing & Deployment for incorporating Facial Verification technology into existing banking apps.

details.heading: Technology internship programme
points: Participated in Bright Network’s Internship Experience UK technology programme.
Worked on Agile software development, communication, product-development planning and management, and testing and deployment for adding facial verification to banking applications.

experience.title: Research Assistant
experience.summary: Served as academic mentor and researcher, guiding undergraduate students in Electronics and Communication as well as Computer Science Engineering on their final year dissertations specialising in Artificial Intelligence for real-world applications, collaborating and publishing Scopus indexed papers in Computer Science & Engineering.

details.heading: Research and undergraduate mentoring
points: Mentored final-year Electronics and Communication Engineering and Computer Science Engineering students on AI applications, collaborating on Scopus-indexed research publications.
Worked with principal investigator Prof. Anu Mehra, contributing expertise in machine learning and deep learning to student projects.
Delivered talks on explainable AI and its real-world applications as part of panels on disruptive technologies.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.summary: Research internship funded by the Ministry of Education, Taiwan as part of TEEP@India program. Designed a software application for recognizing emotions in human speech signals using data analytics, machine learning and signal processing.

details.heading: Speech analysis and recognition
points: Worked on machine learning, pattern recognition and signal processing in the TEEP@India research programme funded by Taiwan’s Ministry of Education.
Designed a software application for automated real-time recognition of emotions in speech, combining predictive machine learning and audio signal processing.

experience.organization: Mentor Graphics (A Siemens Business), Noida, India
experience.summary: Selected among 30 students from across India for the Mentor Higher Education Program on Verification of Electronic Design and Systems using System Verilog. Designed projects including Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter, RISC Microprocessors, and FIFO buffer.

details.heading: Electronic design and verification
points: Selected among 30 students across India for the Mentor Higher Education Program on verification of electronic designs and systems using SystemVerilog.
Used Verilog in projects involving a Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter, 8-bit and 16-bit RISC microprocessors and a First-In-First-Out buffer.

items.title: Data Analytics and Knowledge Engineering
items.summary: Information extraction, knowledge representation and knowledge engineering (proficient).

items.title: Data Preparation
items.summary: SMOTE and other oversampling methods, encoding, imputation, feature scaling and normalisation (proficient); outlier detection (intermediate).

items.title: Natural Language Analytics
items.summary: Paraphrase generation and topic modelling (proficient); text summarisation, semantic labelling and topic identification (intermediate); named-entity recognition and clustering (basic).

items.title: Knowledge Graphs and Ontologies
items.summary: Neo4j graph database development and Cypher (proficient); graph data analytics (intermediate).

items.title: Application Deployment and Cloud
items.summary: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning and Azure App Services; high-performance computing (intermediate); Docker (basic).

items.title: Responsible AI Practices
items.summary: Bias mitigation, fairness, accountability and explainable AI (proficient); privacy, security, reliability and safety (intermediate).

items.title: Software Engineering
items.summary: Large-scale software projects, design and implementation (proficient); testing (intermediate).

items.title: Documentation and Web Development
items.summary: LaTeX (proficient); HTML and CSS (intermediate).

items.title: Engineering and Productivity Tools
items.summary: Control systems and digital electronics; Microsoft Office and macOS iWork (proficient).
